title: Ant-Man and the ants.
lines: Cassie is six and she loves stories.
One day Scott gets a very strange suit.
There's a little button on the hand.
When you press the button, you get as small as an ant.
A blade of grass is as tall as a tree.
A drop of water is as big as a ball.
To Scott the ant is as big as a horse.
Together they run through the grass.
In the suit Scott can also talk to the ants.
Not with words, but with his thoughts.
Her favourite ring has fallen into a hole.
A tiny little hole in the floor.
A hundred ants come marching up.
They walk in a long line.
But the ants chase the spider away.
The ring is heavy for such a small man.
An ant can carry much more than its own weight.
Together the ants lift the ring.
They carry it up, one, two, one, two.
Then Scott presses the button again.
Cassie puts a little piece of sugar in the garden.
And now Scott knows for sure.
You don't have to be big to be a hero.
